alt: Sliced onions turning translucent and glossy in olive oil
Sliced onions collapsed to a deep even gold, sweet not burnt
Slow lazy bubbles breaking the surface of a stew
Ground spices blooming in hot oil
Finely chopped garlic turning pale gold
Fish flesh turning opaque, flakes beginning to separate
Chicken golden and firm, juices running clear
Vegetable edges caught and darkened, centres still soft
Soft moist egg curds forming, glossy not dry
Sauce coating the back of a spoon
Steamed rice grains falling apart separately
Noodles soft and pliable with no white core
A deep brown crust forming on beef, top still raw
Oats and seeds turning golden in a dry pan, no oil
Spinach collapsing to a glossy bright green
